item.title: Copilot wipes entire files when trying to make changes
item.body:
Type: Bug Chat keeps getting in this loop where all it can do is completely wipe out entire files when it says it's going to make a targeted change. It tries to undo with this: ``` The file got wiped again. I think the issue is with how I'm using the insert_edit_into_file tool. Let me restore it from git and try a different approach: ``` but this is dangerous if you haven't committed recently. undoing the changes manually and redoing the command results in an endless loop of it deleting the entire file and then wondering why it happened. Needs a new agent or a restart of VSCode to go back to normal behavior.
